quest.title: Return to Days of Winter
quest.description: Viktor, a Fatuus stationed in Mondstadt, has finally received orders to return home...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, I guess I'm finally heading home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leaving us, Viktor?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, it's you...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's correct. I received orders from above recently that I can return to Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Something about me being transferred to another Harbinger, and no longer needing to standby in Mondstadt for any new orders.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I've got no clue which of them I'll be under this time, but I'm just praying that it's not Lord Scaramouche...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When will you be leaving?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The higher-ups didn't mention that. I was just told to pack my things and be ready to leave at a moment's notice.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I mean, that's great, right? Finally, I'll be free from the judging gazes of those Sisters!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ah, right, Traveler. Seeing as how we've had dealings for so long... Won't you do a man one last favor?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Like before, you'll do the deed, and I'll cough up the payment. You'll never work for free when you work with me.

choices.text: What stories will you tell me this time?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Haha. To tell the truth, I'm all out of Fatui stories to tell you.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: The payment this time will be Mora for sure. Sounds good?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Well, unless you'd like me to tell you the same fairy tales I tell Lily...

choices.text: What do you need help with?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: You know what? I'll come clean. The request this time also has something to do with her.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: She's... well, the only person in all of Mondstadt who'll listen to anything "the evil Fatui uncle" says — other than you, of course.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I doubt I'll be returning to Mondstadt ever again... So I just wanted to send Lily one last memento.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: But as you know, I'd be walking into a shooting gallery if I were to just walk out there and buy something.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: So I can only leave this task to you.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Just head over to Marjorie's and help me see if she's got any gifts that a child might like.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Err... Well... Sometimes...

choices.text: Aye, never a lack of Fatui stories with you around...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any gifts for kids here?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: A gift for a child... Let me think.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hmm, actually, I've been attempting to fashion some small toys recently.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: The only catch is that they need a lot of Wolfhook dye, and I'm all out of Wolfhooks.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I asked Schuster to help me gather some more, but he hasn't returned yet.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Could you help me look for Schuster, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Once we have enough Wolfhooks, I should be able to make those toys for you.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: In that case, I'm counting on you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Did you get the present?

choices.text: What will you do once you get back home?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: What will I do? Well... I suppose I'll have to wait for my transfer orders.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: *sigh* If things go ill, I might get transferred to some archon-forsaken place and put on standby again.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: But I'm fine with whatever, so long as they don't toss me over to Inazuma...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Why, you ask? It's because of Lady Signora's... Well... her sacrifice.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Actually, you know what? I'm just a joiner. I listen to orders. There's no need for me to think too much.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I heard Rudolf mention that he was going to take her out to the square or something like that.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Heh. I suppose he's got to keep his precious daughter away from the evil Fatui, eh?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Alright. I leave the matter of the present to you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: These monsters just kept coming after me, even after I ran all the way here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You came to gather some Wolfhooks, right?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Eh? Yeah, it was Marjorie's request...

choices.text: Couldn't you have brought someone else with you?

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: ...Come on, who would've agreed to come with me to work on a commission as simple as "gathering plants"?

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: I know how that's supposed to work, of course, but you can only find Wolfhooks here, you know?

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: And the Wolfhooks that grow in safer areas have all been picked.

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: So I had to go further in to gather Wolfhooks...

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: But let's not talk about that now. Could you help me pass these Wolfhooks to Marjorie?

response.speaker: Terrified Schuster
response.text: I need a moment to rest. I thought my legs were going to give out on me back there...

choices.text: Please don't go out so far by yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Did you manage to find Schuster, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He asked me to take these Wolfhooks back to you.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Ah! Thank you very much. I'll take these, then.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Once Schuster gets back, I'll make sure he gets paid.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Right, you wanted a gift for a child, yes? Well then. Coming right up...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Marjorie starts to make the present...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Well, that's a wrap! Here, take this. Thanks for bringing those Wolfhooks back, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This doll has a light scent to it, too. I'm sure the kid you're sending this to will love it.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you get the present?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Huh, I guess you're pretty good. Now let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What is this...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: This doll's all gangly and crooked, and its dye-job looks ridiculous... Well, it certainly smells nice, though.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Are you sure this is suitable for children?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: This gift will have to do. But where do I put the letter... Eh, you know what, I'll just put it underneath...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Just some nonsense. Never you mind.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Alright. Here, take it, and help me deliver it to Lily. She should be <color=#00E1FFFF>near the square</color>.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Heh. I can picture the stares I'd be getting from Rudolf if I were to give it to her myself already...

choices.text: What did you write to her?
You could always buy one in Snezhnaya and have it shipped here.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Oh, I'd love to. But just think about it. If a Fatuus were to send anything to Mondstadt, wouldn't it get stopped at the city gates by the Knights of Favonius?

talks.objective: Deliver the present to Lily in turn

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily, you shouldn't be talking to that Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But why not? Mister Fatooey's told me loadsa stowies!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there, Lily, Viktor got you a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Wow! Mister Fatooey got me a pwesent? Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Wait, why would that Fatuus send Lily a present? Don't tell me that he...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: That's becoz I gave Mister Fatooey lots of stuff to eat! That's why he sent me a gift!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily, he's not a good person...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But he tells me stowies! He's a good guy!

choices.text: You can consider this Viktor's farewell gift.

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Eh? Why does he have to go...

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: *sigh* He's leaving? Fine. I was beside myself with worry every day, what with that fellow talking to Lily every day and all.

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Dadda, I wanna say bye bye to the Fatooey man!

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: *sigh* Lily, you shouldn't get too close to that man.

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: But why? That Fatooey... He's been really nice to me!

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: He tells me stowies. Lots of stowies! He's nice!

response.speaker: Rudolf
response.text: Lily, listen to Daddy. Things aren't that simple... *sigh* You know what? Daddy will tell you more when you're older.

choices.text: Viktor's going to leave Mondstadt soon.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Did you send the present to Lily?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's as pleased as punch.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's good. I suppose Rudolf had his own two Mora's worth to say on the subject?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hmph, you don't even have to say it. No one trusts a Fatuus here in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When are you leaving?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The official order hasn't come down yet. I've just packed my things in advance, and I'll be staying at the Goth Grand Hotel for the time being — ready to leave at a moment's notice.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Come on, what's with that serious expression? Are you going to formally bid me farewell?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hah, that's right. That's how it should be. We're not friends. We're just ad-hoc partners.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: If you should ever come to Snezhnaya, you can look for me there. We can continue doing business.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Alright, enough small talk. Here's your payment. Take it. I suppose this will be our last "equivalent exchange" here in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* I just hope my next assignment isn't as troublesome...

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily, you shouldn't be talking to that Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But why not? Mister Fatooey's told me loadsa stowies!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Could you help me deliver these Wolfhooks to Marjorie? I just need a moment to rest. I thought my legs were going to give out on me back there...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Help me deliver the present to Lily. She should be <color=#00E1FFFF>near the city square</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: If I were to go myself, I'm sure Rudolf would be glaring daggers at me all the way...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But Dadda, he really is a good guy, and he tells great stowies!

dialogues.speaker: Rudolf
dialogues.text: Lily, things aren't that simple... *sigh* You know what? Daddy will tell you more when you're older.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* I just hope my next assignment isn't as troublesome...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, I guess I'm finally heading home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leaving us, Viktor?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, it's you...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's correct. I received orders from above recently that I can return to Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Something about me being transferred to another Harbinger, and no longer needing to standby in Mondstadt for any new orders.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I've got no clue which of them I'll be under this time, though...
